data.description:
**NEW UPDATE:**  Our festive fan-favorite Santa Simulator now has had a major overhaul with updated visuals, enhanced gameplay, and an all-new in-game leaderboard. Share the magic of VR this holiday season!

Richie's Plank Experience was designed to invoke the strongest possible emotions in the shortest possible time. Test your fear of heights or entertain your friends and family as they walk the plank 80 stories high and experience terrifying real fear, knees weak and palms sweaty!

Once you have mastered the art of walking the plank, crank it up a notch and see if you can make it through Nightmare mode. Our Halloween-themed experience is a great way to scare you and your guests during the spooky season. Have you ever wondered what it feels like to fly? With our Hero Academy, you can fly through the city like a superhero, take out rockets or fight fires. After something calmer? Paint a rainbow in Skybrush mode.

Spread cheer in VR with our Christmas-themed Santa Simulator for the whole family! Travel through a snow-coated city and compete on the all-new in-game leaderboard and see who can deliver the most presents. This charming and festive experience is perfect for kids and families during the holiday season.

# Warning: This game invokes a near-instant emotional reaction. Due to the nature of virtual reality, this experience can affect your balance, cause dizziness and affect your decision-making ability. Follow our in-game Safety Guidelines to remove the risk of injury or harm.

changelog.change_log:
Update to Nightmare Mode including better lighting, more spiders and improved art
General art fixes across the city
Update to recentering feature to improve user experience
General fixes, updates and preparation for Meta Quest 3S

* Limited-time secret feature has been removed from Richie’s Plank Experience. Thanks to everyone for participating!
* Improved road textures.

* Secret feature added to Richie’s Plank Experience elevator for a limited time only. Think you’ve got what it takes to uncover a hidden surprise?
* Various minor bug fixes to improve game experience.
Addresses issues with EULA/Health & Safety navigation, pause functionality as well as minor optimisation and stability fixes.
Fixes issue where the Santa Simulator grab buttons are mapped incorrectly.
Minor bug fixes in Nightmare Mode and Santa Simulator.
Minor art update on main billboard.

* Made gifts spawn in exact starting positions and start simulating in virtual space immediately to eliminated any physics issues
* Reduced respawn time of gifts
* Removed any physics starting issues with change to simulation architecture
* Further tweaked colliders to clear the exit button regardless of what gifts might be there
* Moved velocity calculations to lateupdate to remove race conditions
* Re-baked canyon to allow build
* Removed probuilder mesh from RPE scene that was causing build issue due to malformed color array
* Made clear separation of resetting gifts and respawning gifts
* Gave gifts the authority to handle the behaviour of their reset and respawn orientation
* Fixed bug where hand interaction pinch was working intermittently for UI elements such as "next" button
* Fixed bug where going back to EULA 2nd time would not show next button, making user stuck
* Fixed bad scale on the dlc panel in some edge cases
* Fixed issue where dlc panel incorrectly opens when leaving hero academy instead of on arrive at plank
* Replaced shooting star particle shader in order to fix culling / weird render order issue
Hot fix to address mipmapping issues.
Hotfix to remove FFR effect on Quest 3.

🔸Added Mixed Reality plank setup. 
🔸Added passthrough elevator mode. With option to turn it on and off inside the elevator. 
🔸Added optional Canyon DLC

City Graphics Improvements:
🔸Stronger fog
🔸Fog clamped to max 80% influence.
🔸Improved the road textures
🔸Much Larger AO distance. This gives nicer AO from whole buildings. Not just nooks.
🔸Increase light strength to compensate for larger AO distance.
🔸Photoscan elements added under plank top floor and to the right top floor.
🔸Lower horizon on sky box.
🔸Added mountains to sky box to blend in better with mesh mountains and add extra layer.
🔸Scaled down terrain height on Y axis. Didn't think it'd work, but it did! Especially with improved mountains.
🔸Removed plants either side of plank on ground floor.
🔸Made elevator use light probes instead of light bake.
🔸Added light casting on to ground from the elevator.
🔸Added more vertex colouring to more buildings.
🔸Added tree back in the park.
🔸More clouds at various heights between plank and ground.
🔸Desaturated colours in atlas texture.
🔸Changed some of the old building textures to more modern glass building layouts. Main one was building to the immediate left of the plank.
🔸Added better noise detail to the normal map for glass of buildings. This gives the bowing glass effect that happens in real life. Either from wind or from age or from mounting flex.
🔸Added slight variation to the base normal map colour of some windows using photoshop. This adds a slight variation in angle to the base layer of each pane of glass. This simulates the slight variation in mounting angle of glass. This added a weakness of some showing relfection as smaller or bigger sometimes. I feel like the benefit still outweighed this negative.
🔸Added bin to the right of ground floor to hide weaknesses in the building join.
🔸Added low fence to the park. Huge improvement!
🔸Added low railing to roofs of buildings closest to the plank.
🔸Reduced overhang of building across from plank. This exposes more nice glass.
🔸3x higher quality light bake.
🔸Added more fake shadows to break up boring street to the left of the plank.
🔸Bigger god ray on top floor. Adjusted colour and strength.

Free Christmas Update! On the ground floor, next to the elevator, you'll find a bell. Give it a ring to take a sleigh ride from the North Pole to the city. 
Enjoy the scenery or become Santa and deliver presents to everyone on your good list.

Fixed the crash bug for some users who haven't got the Oculus System update yet.
Fixed the right controller bug when hand tracking is enabled.
Re-enabled the re-centering option. (Still use plank setup if using a real plank)
Adjusted lighting of hand tracking shader.

Crash bug is fixed.
Hand tracking re-enabled. 
Quest 2 controller positions are fixed.
